items.title: SwitchHDR, an AI model for HDR reconstruction from SDR video
items.excerpt: Beeble's SwitchHDR is a machine-learning model that reconstructs HDR imagery from ordinary SDR video for professional post, addressing the reality that most existing footage is SDR while productions increasingly demand HDR-quality assets.

items.title: Tilly Norwood creator developing feature film 'Misaligned' starring the AI actor
items.excerpt: Particle 6, the UK company behind AI-generated 'actor' Tilly Norwood, is developing its first feature, the comedy-drama 'Misaligned,' using a hybrid production model that pairs traditional filmmaking roles with AI specialists — a concrete test of how synthetic-performer pipelines reshape a production.

items.title: Puget Systems at SIGGRAPH 2026: an immersive Robo Dojo
items.excerpt: ProVideo Coalition's SIGGRAPH 2026 dispatch spotlights AI-driven creative tools on the show floor: Beeble AI and District Cinema ran the new SwitchLight 3 model on native 4K cinematic footage from Corridor Crew's 'Son of a Dungeon' S3 to generate production-ready PBR relighting passes inside Unreal Engine, and Keyshot Studio's 'AI Shots' made focused generative edits while respecting CAD data and lighting — a concrete look at generative relighting in a real production pipeline.

items.title: Beeble Releases SwitchHDR, an AI Model for HDR Reconstruction From SDR Video
items.excerpt: Beeble's SwitchHDR is an AI frontier model that reconstructs HDR imagery from ordinary SDR video, outputting scene-linear 16-bit EXR sequences for professional post. It targets the reality that most existing footage is SDR while productions increasingly demand HDR-quality assets.
